We store the domain and optional DKIM se: We store the domain and optional DKIM selectors you submit, scan timestamps and status, and the diagnostic results. Results can include DNS records, mail-server hostnames and IP addresses, SMTP responses, and TLS certificate details. Published DNS records and server responses may contain personal data, such as contact email addresses.
Scans query public DNS, connect to mail: Scans query public DNS, connect to mail servers, and may retrieve a domain’s MTA-STS policy over HTTPS. They do not access mailboxes, ask for mail credentials, or read your emails. SMTP checks stop before sending a message body; no test email is delivered.
We use this information to run the diagn: We use this information to run the diagnostics you request, display and share reports, troubleshoot failures, and protect the service from abuse. Where this involves personal data, we rely on our legitimate interests in providing a useful, secure diagnostic service. We do not use scan data for advertising or profiling, or sell it.
Anyone with a report link can view its r: Anyone with a report link can view its results and download its JSON export without signing in. Treat report links as shareable, and only submit domains you are comfortable including in a report.
Reports expire :days days after the scan: Reports expire :days days after the scan is created and are then no longer available through the site or export. Expired scans and their related results are removed by the scheduled daily cleanup.
The site uses essential session and secu: The site uses essential session and security cookies to keep forms working and protect against forged requests. Your browser’s language preference selects English or Dutch. The app does not include advertising cookies or analytics trackers.
Your IP address is used to limit scan re: Your IP address is used to limit scan requests and prevent abuse. We store operational logs, including IP addresses, user agents, request details, and errors, for 30 days, then delete them. These logs help us secure the service, investigate abuse, and diagnose faults. This is separate from the report retention period described above.
Hosting and infrastructure providers pro: Hosting and infrastructure providers process data needed to run the service. DNS resolvers and the servers being checked receive the relevant DNS queries or network connections and may log them. External links, including GitHub and ward.nl, have their own privacy policies and receive your request when you follow them.
Where applicable, you can request access: Where applicable, you can request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data, request restriction or portability, and object to processing based on legitimate interests. Email
with your request and, if relevant, the: with your request and, if relevant, the report link. Please do not post personal data in a public GitHub issue.
